tools.name: search_leads
tools.description: Search the businesses this LeadsIt account has already found, best sales score first, with their emails, phones, websites and social profiles. Put every filter in one call; the result has the total that match. Use offset to page. format "csv" returns a CSV file of up to 5,000 rows for a spreadsheet.

tools.name: create_lead_search
tools.description: Start a live search for one business type in one city: LeadsIt searches public business listings live, then reads each business website for emails, phones and social profiles. Spends 1 search credit, so check search_leads first. Takes 1 to 4 minutes; set waitSeconds (up to 50) to wait here, or poll

tools.name: get_search_status
tools.description: Status and lead count of a search. waitSeconds (up to 50) waits until it finishes. Free.

tools.name: list_searches
tools.description: The searches this account ran, newest first, with their status and number of leads. Free.

tools.name: analyze_company_website
tools.description: Read a company website and suggest who it sells to: the business type and the place to search next with create_lead_search. Accounts with a pack or plan. Free.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The account plan, search credits, AI actions and how many leads it holds. Free.

tools.name: company_search
tools.description: Search every active French establishment (official SIRENE register, updated daily) by activity and place: trade or NAF codes, then a town with a radius, postcodes or a département, head-count bands, creation dates, and recent events (new, hiring, receivership, closed, moved, sale). tools.name: follow_target
tools.description: Follow an activity in a place (e.g. plumbers within 10 km of Lyon): LeadsIt checks the company base every day and its Monday email lists the new establishments, closures, moves, receiverships, sales and hiring there; read them any time with company_events and the followId. tools.name: list_follows
tools.description: The targets this account follows on the company base (activity × place), with their followId for company_events, whether they are active, the week's counts by event kind and the latest establishments seen. Free.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_leads, create_lead_search, company_search, follow_target · Private data: search_leads · Public sink: follow_target · Destructive: search_leads.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_leads, create_lead_search, company_search, follow_target · Private data: search_leads · Public sink: follow_target · Destructive: search_leads

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
